pr.platforms: All transitively affected platforms; shared runtime changes include every consuming platform
pr.nestBusinessControls: Required comparisons for affected Fastify/Express work; report gaps without making parity a completion condition.
pr.nativeControls: Same-runtime native controls required; preserve drift and metric semantics.

periodic.targets: All native/fluo/Nest variants in the frozen harness inventory, including Next App and Pages

required: load region and direct traffic path
actual deployed correctness and timing evidence
provider resource evidence with explicit metric semantics

environments.workers: local workerd; deployed acceptance is separate
environments.nextjs: production Node App and Pages; Edge excluded

freezeOrder: owner selects policy and Nest goal
validate current BEFORE identity and complete samples
freeze condition-level B values and policy
baseline.priorDiagnostics: Preserved as exploration only; no retrospective budget PASS. Final acceptance requires complete post-freeze matched evidence with explicit harness/serving-source identities.

sampling.order: Three adjacent BEFORE/candidate blocks with alternating arm order; same-runtime native controls and required Nest comparisons retained.
sampling.noisyResult: Stop and report INCONCLUSIVE; change environment or protocol only as a separately declared comparison
sampling.durationCalibration: Before candidate collection, freeze max(15, ceil(24000 / historical BEFORE minimum requests/second)) per scenario/configuration/concurrency across selected targets. Both arms use the same duration. Unknown new targets require BEFORE-only calibration, not candidate-driven extension.
sampling.rationale: Retain the established 3-repeat 5s/15s protocol rather than silently expanding to a 5-repeat 10s/40s matrix. Require all three paired ratios and reject unstable or underpowered conditions; do not claim statistical significance.

metrics.serverCpuMicrosPerRequest: 1e6 * measured server-process-tree CPU seconds / completed measured requests
metrics.rssBytes: Maximum sampled simultaneous server-process-tree RSS during measurement; 250ms sampling
metrics.aggregation: Median of 3 per-run values for each condition and subject
metrics.latencyMeaning: Median of run percentiles, not a pooled request percentile
metrics.resourceBoundary: Identical BEFORE/candidate process tree and interval definition; warmup excluded

stability.statisticalClaim: Bounded operational screen, not proof of significance or maximum capacity

regressionBudget.B: Median of 3 validated current BEFORE runs for this exact condition
regressionBudget.A: Median of 3 validated candidate runs for this exact condition
regressionBudget.pairedRequirement: All 3 paired ratios meet each corresponding budget limit; no cross-condition offset or automatic repeat-until-pass.

regression-only.nestRatios: Report only; no competitiveness acceptance claim

failClosedOn: missing raw traffic histogram or resource trace
missing or inconsistent serving runtime/source/build identity
recorded invalid attempts or interrupted collection
unexpected status, non-2xx, body or request-identity mismatch
malformed, non-finite or impossible metric values
missing required profiling trace or its runtime/source identity
requiredIdentity: Clean executed Git head plus serving-source identity; generated raw outputs must not hide source changes
actual serving runtime and host engine versions
validity.profiling: Separate captures and controls; instrumented timing cannot substitute for uninstrumented gate timing
validity.unsupportedMetric: Explicit UNSUPPORTED; never zero or evidence of improvement

capacity.localWorkersCpuMeaning: Wrangler/workerd process-tree cost, not deployed isolate CPU

amendment.approvedOption: Do not ship unproven performance candidates. Complete measurement/limitations reports and verified harness fixes through review, GitHub CI, merge, cleanup and retrospective.
amendment.supersedes: The requirement to obtain passing new candidate performance matrices before completing these issue work units. It does not supersede numerical verdicts, correctness contracts or merge verification gates.
requiredOutcomes: Exclude unproven shared-header and Node request-wrapper runtime candidates from the final diffs through new ordinary commits; preserve historical candidate commits and original evidence.

Keep only independently justified regression tests and verified benchmark tooling. Restore public runtime behavior and remove candidate-only release entries when the final published package surface is unchanged.
Report original FAIL, INCONCLUSIVE, unsupported and incomplete conditions without relabeling them as PASS, absent evidence or performance improvement.
Complete per-issue reports and a final consolidated disposition that distinguishes engineering workflow completion from unestablished performance acceptance.
Retain exact-head reviews, focused checks appropriate to the final change, full GitHub CI, mergeability checks and existing merge/cleanup authority.
Archive local evidence outside disposable worktrees before cleanup and produce one lane retrospective.
nonGoals: No new large acceptance matrix or repeat-until-pass measurement.
No numerical threshold relaxation, outlier deletion or diagnostic-to-acceptance promotion.
No new speculative optimization, public API change, security reduction or React implementation.
No new deployed requests, paid services, local package publishing or global NAS configuration changes.
